comments.body: Measured recovery (output): conservative-correct shard (load-bearing prose kept). executor.py 791->790; net recovery is correction/relocation-dominated, not volume. Corrected P1-P9->P1-P11 where enumerating current DET floor (kept 2 seam-boundary sites); orchestrator+yaml blocking-set + short-circuit prose corrected to match authoritative workflow_ops.py:153 (story 228b: ANY DET block short-circuits, llm_ran=False). reuse.py 4 wrong line cites generalized to symbols. 3 ADRs: 0064 (additive-only manifest), 0065 (Burr tripwire), 0066 (gate-context-never-elided, retains withdrawn signed-false-PASS vector). Byte-pin (bug 96d1 attest.py+pass1.py) UNTOUCHED. Tripwire test_executor_tripwire.py green+unmodified. Untracked follow-ups filed: e907, 5623 (discovered_from ad16). Gates: lint+typecheck green; 815 plan_review+workflow tests passed. Change 1545.

compiled_state.description:
Scope: `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/**` (38 files) and `src/rebar/llm/workflow/**` (26 files). ~230 lines leave of 24,304 LOC — only 0.9%, because this subtree's prose is unusually load-bearing (fail-open/fail-closed contracts, byte-compat pins, patch-seam invariants).

36 of 38 history blocks already cite a ticket id, so most of the work is 'reduce to the citation'. Only two are costly: untracked follow-ups in `production_batch_runner.py` that must be filed first.

Verified stale: SIX sites say 'the deterministic floor (P1-P9)' while `DET_CHECKS` has 11 entries and `registry.CANONICAL_DET` runs P1..P11; `orchestrator.py:9` additionally misstates which checks block. `reuse.py:36-37` cites four line numbers, all four wrong.

Three new ADRs: the unversioned additive-only attestation manifest; the Burr tripwire (a 4-condition adoption trigger list spread across three docstrings, with a test asserting the prose exists); gate context is never elided (including a WITHDRAWN alternative documented as a signed-false-PASS vector).

Biggest headroom win: `workflow/executor.py` 791 -> ~769, almost entirely from three 'so this module stays under the module-size cap' notes.

Byte-pinned json.dumps rationale in attest.py/pass1.py is maintainer-blessed and must stay verbatim — converging it would invalidate live attestations.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every non-KEEP unit in scope is relocated or deleted per its destination
- [ ] The shard's do_not_move list is appended to `.joe-janitor/tools.md` BEFORE any edit lands
- [ ] Verified-stale comments are corrected where they document a live invariant, deleted only where obsolete
- [ ] No load-bearing invariant is lost; measured-fact and anti-refactor warnings stay verbatim
## CORRECTION (plan-review preempt + test-safety, parent 373f disposition vocabulary)

This is the most load-bearing shard (fail-open/fail-closed contracts, byte-compat pins, a
docstring pinned by a live test). Superseding ACs below encode the 373f disposition rules plus
the specific test-safety and byte-pin constraints this subtree requires.

## Acceptance Criteria (supersedes the list above)

- [ ] Every substantial in-scope comment unit is dispositioned into exactly one parent-373f
      label: RELOCATE (to an ADR / docs / ticket, reduced to a one-line citation), DELETE, KEEP,
      DO_NOT_MOVE, or CORRECT-IN-PLACE.
- [ ] Decision rule CORRECT-vs-DELETE: a comment documenting CURRENT runtime behavior / a live
      invariant is CORRECTED in place; DELETE only when its referent no longer exists. Every
      DELETE records its reason (referenced-artifact-gone / superseded) in the commit body or a
      ticket comment.
- [ ] The stale "P1-P9" enumerations (written with BOTH a hyphen "P1-P9" and an en-dash
      "P1–P9" across the sites) are CORRECTED to the matching "P1-P11"/"P1–P11" ONLY where the site claims to
      enumerate the CURRENT full DET floor (CANONICAL_DET is P1..P11; DET_CHECKS has 11 entries,
      P10/P11 in det_clarity). Where "P1–P9" deliberately names the pre-clarity STATIC floor as a
      seam boundary (e.g. a "runs BEFORE / not a DET_CHECKS entry" note), it is KEPT — read each
      site's context, do not blind-replace. `orchestrator.py:9`'s misstatement of WHICH checks
      block is corrected to the real blocking set (P1 / P5-cycle / P8 / P10 / P11, per
      det_floor.py:733).
- [ ] `reuse.py:36-37`'s four wrong line-number citations are corrected to the actual lines (or
      the citation is generalized to the symbol name if the target moves).
- [ ] TEST-SAFETY (Burr tripwire): `tests/unit/workflow/test_executor_tripwire.py` asserts, on
      the executor source, that `"burr"` appears AND at least four of `1.`/`2.`/`3.`/`4.` survive,
      and that the fan-out module's text contains `"rationale"`. The tripwire prose may be
      compressed/reworded and its full rationale RELOCATED to a new ADR, but executor.py MUST
      still contain `"burr"` + the four-item numbered trigger list, and the fan-out module MUST
      still contain `"rationale"`. Do NOT edit this test. Run it and confirm green after the edit.
- [ ] BYTE-PIN (DO_NOT_MOVE, verbatim): the bug-96d1 byte-exact-recomputation rationale stays
      verbatim — the grandfather note in `plan_review/attest.py` (~646-649) AND the
      `json.dumps(basis, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False)` rationale in `plan_review/pass1.py`
      (~753, ~770): a signed hash must byte-exactly match the legacy recomputation, so converging
      or rewording it would invalidate live attestations. This is bug 96d1 ONLY — do NOT attribute
      it to story 9374, which names the separate warm-gate measured bytes (pass1.py:58). Do not
      touch the 96d1 rationale.
- [ ] Untracked follow-ups: any prose in `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/production_batch_runner.py`
      (note: this file lives under plan_review/, NOT workflow/) describing future work WITHOUT a
      ticket id is FILED as a rebar ticket and linked `discovered_from` this ticket BEFORE its
      comment is collapsed to the new id. (Report the ids you file.)
- [ ] Three new ADRs are created with unique unused numbers (>= 0064): the additive-only
      unversioned attestation manifest; the Burr adoption tripwire (fuller home for the executor
      trigger list); and the "gate context is never elided" contract (INCLUDING the WITHDRAWN
      alternative documented as a signed-false-PASS vector — keep that warning). Each ADR EXISTS
      and is committed before any comment citing it is collapsed. Provenance line: epic b5bc;
      ticket ad16.
- [ ] `workflow/executor.py` may shrink (the three self-referential "so this module stays under
      the module-size cap" notes are removable narration) but MUST stay <= 800 lines and MUST NOT
      exceed the cap.
- [ ] The shard's do_not_move list is appended to `.joe-janitor/tools.md` BEFORE any edit lands;
      lint/type pragmas and test-introspected docstrings are DO_NOT_MOVE.
- [ ] The actual recovered comment-line count is measured (by diff) and recorded on this ticket
      as an OUTPUT, not a target.
- [ ] No behaviour change: the full test suite AND `make lint` / `make typecheck` pass unchanged.
